title: SWAP5 WOFOST81 Migration Preservation

validated_semantics: prepare phase cannot mutate committed crop or N state
root/stem gross growth is reconstructed from net growth plus same-step death
N request consumes committed pre-step crop and N state
external N supply is a separate second phase
invalid supply cannot leak crop or N mutation into committed state
successful supply produces a valid N-balanced composite candidate while committed state remains bitwise unchanged
one_day_candidate_qualification.scope: canonical-shaped composition qualification; actual repository integration compile still required

architecture_decision: Retain the unchanged legacy WOFOST path. WOFOST81 uses a versioned composite crop+N owner and an explicit two-phase one-day candidate: prepare computes carbon/rates/structure plus an N request from committed pre-step state; apply accepts external Soil-N supply into the candidate only.
scientific_interpretation: All WOFOST81 component semantics required to construct an atomic one-day crop+N candidate are now qualified in isolation. The next gate is not new physics: it is compiling and exercising these exact committed modules against the actual SWAP5 repository interfaces before any runtime reachability or ten-case full-season preservation campaign.
non_branch_git_objects_note: Unreferenced blob writes created during connector transport; they are not reachable from the PP02 branch or canonical and are not evidence.
next_permitted_action: Add a full-repository PP02 integration compile/run gate using the actual SWAP5 crop/transaction modules and the committed WOFOST81 files. Construct a valid common WOFOST rate bundle with the public constructors, compile with warnings-as-errors, verify two-phase candidate behavior without qualification stubs, and only then start the ten-case PP01 preservation replay. Do not activate production runtime yet.
exclusions: no replacement of existing legacy WOFOST path
